label: System voltage
hint: Nominal supply in V (12 / 24 / 48 V are examples, not defaults).

label: Operating voltage range
hint: Minimum / maximum V, crank and brownout conditions.

label: Transient noise
hint: Motors, pumps, switching loads and operating environment; source evidence.

label: Sleep current
hint: Maximum target in mA and sleep / wake conditions.

label: Supply protection
hint: Reverse polarity, overcurrent, overvoltage and load-dump requirement; applicable test specification.

label: Cellular network
hint: Network technology, bands, coverage and operator requirements.

label: Usage region
hint: Country / region, deployment and roaming constraints.

label: SIM type
hint: Removable SIM / eSIM, provisioning and service owner.

label: Satellite / GNSS
hint: GPS / NavIC or other required constellations, antenna and accuracy.

label: CAN lines
hint: Count, Classic / FD, speed and purpose such as UDS / IVN.

label: CAN termination
hint: Whether / where 120-ohm termination is required; topology.

label: Storage / memory
hint: Capacity, retention, endurance, offline data and SD / flash / eMMC constraints.

label: Digital inputs
hint: Count, signal levels, ignition / switches, thresholds and protection.

label: Digital outputs
hint: Count, voltage, current, load type and safe state.

label: High / low switching
hint: Separate high-side and low-side counts, current and protection.

label: Analog inputs
hint: Count, sensor voltage / current ranges, accuracy and sampling.

label: External serial ports
hint: USB / UART / RS232 / RS485, counts, speed and connector / isolation.

label: IP rating
hint: Required ingress rating, installation conditions and test evidence.

label: Dimensions & weight
hint: Maximum L × W × H in mm, weight, mounting and connector clearance.

label: Internal battery
hint: Required or not; runtime in h, capacity, chemistry, charging and safety.

label: Certifications
hint: Client / region requirements and applicable editions; no certification is inferred.

label: Operating temperature
hint: Explicit minimum / maximum °C, duty cycle and any required grade.

label: Use case & acceptance
hint: Intended use, user / vehicle interfaces, acceptance criteria and exclusions.

label: Volumes & build stages
hint: PoC, pilot and production quantities; milestones do not authorize bulk release.

label: Delivery milestones
hint: Required dates, dependencies, installation and handover acceptance.

label: Cost & commercial constraints
hint: Target cost, currency and commercial constraints; restricted financial records remain separate.

label: Sourcing & component availability
hint: Lead times, lifecycle, approved alternates and supplier / part master references.

label: Firmware & software integration
hint: Protocols, API / HSI, update method, cybersecurity and ownership.

label: Manufacturing readiness
hint: Assembly process, capacity, tooling, traceability and process controls.

label: Validation & production testing
hint: Acceptance limits, methods, sample size, jig / EOL needs and evidence references.

label: Data & infrastructure
hint: Hosting, data access, retention, privacy, deployment and backup expectations.

label: Training & support readiness
hint: Required skills, installation / operator training, support handover and resource gaps.

label: Service & maintainability
hint: Diagnostics, repair, spare parts, warranty assumptions and escalation.

label: Special requirements & open questions
hint: Additional requirements, unresolved assumptions and who must supply clarification.
